title: Schedule of Insured Perils and Exclusions, Pass and Trip Protection
content:
Each plan under Pass and Trip Protection names the events it pays out on and the events it never pays out
on. This schedule is the list for all six plans.

| Plan | Events paid out on | Events never paid out on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | Medical injury; medical illness | Change of mind; poor snow; loss of employment; permanent move |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | Medical injury; medical illness; loss of employment | Change of mind; poor snow; permanent move |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | Medical injury; medical illness; loss of employment; permanent move; mountain closure | Change of mind; poor snow |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | Medical injury; medical illness; travel disruption | Change of mind; poor snow; loss of employment; permanent move |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | Medical injury; medical illness; loss of employment; travel disruption; mountain closure | Change of mind; poor snow; permanent move |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | Medical injury; medical illness; loss of employment; permanent move; mountain closure; travel disruption; bereavement | Change of mind |

**Points of judgement.** Change of mind is named in the excluded list of every one of the six plans, and poor
snow in five of them, the Collective Total Protection Concierge plan alone leaving poor snow out of its
exclusions without naming it among the events it pays out on. Loss of employment and a permanent move each
appear as an insured event on some plans and as an exclusion on others: loss of employment is insured under
Season Pass Protection Plus, Season Pass Protection Premier, Collective Trip Protection Elite and the
Collective Total Protection Concierge plan, and excluded under Season Pass Protection Basic and Collective
Trip Protection Standard. Bereavement is named as an insured event by the Collective Total Protection
Concierge plan only.
